meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据讲出有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在汇报中把数据讲得动人
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your data presentations more compelling.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把数据整理成有故事结构的叙述（铺垫→冲突→解决），产出报告或演示要点，并用数据、叙事、图表三部分支撑结论。
howto.when: 当你向管理层汇报分析、做季度业务回顾或写数据报告等场景时，它会接管这类数据的组织与表达。

say.text: 把这份季度数据整理成给高管的演示要点
say.note: 按故事结构组织并给出建议

say.text: 用这份销售数据讲一个带冲突和结论的故事
say.note: 按钩子→背景→洞察→行动输出

say.text: 这份报告数据太多，帮我砍到三个要点
say.note: 会删减数据、突出核心洞察

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns raw data into a narrative using a setup–conflict–resolution structure, producing reports or presentation points built on three pillars: data, narrative, and visuals.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, creating quarterly business reviews, or building investor presentations.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly data into executive presentation points
say_en.note: Structured as a story with recommendations

say_en.text: Use this sales data to tell a story with a conflict and a conclusion
This report has too much data - cut it to three key points
say_en.note: Cuts data and highlights core insights
